Roof Replacement Estimate Atlanta

You're looking for a reliable contractor to replace your roof in Atlanta, and you want a clear estimate for the work. On this site, you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your roof replacement project, and we'll respond within one business day.

How Roof Replacement Works with Build Heritage

We serve the metro Atlanta area, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. Our team of experts will work with you to assess your roof's condition and provide a detailed estimate for the replacement. We offer roofing as one of our 8 trades, and our cost guide provides ranges for full roof replacement, from $9,000 to $20,000. We advise holding back 10-15% on top of the quote for any hidden issues that may arise.

What You Get and What It Costs

Our quotes are free and itemized, so you can see exactly what you're paying for. We're licensed and insured in Georgia, and we stand by our work. Our cost guide, updated in August 2026, provides ranges for various services, including whole-home interior repaint, which can cost between $3,000 and $8,000.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We serve metro Atlanta and Georgia, including cities like Atlanta, Marietta, and Alpharetta. How long does it take to get a quote? We respond to quote requests within one business day. Do you offer other services besides roofing? Yes, we offer 8 trades, including painting, drywall, and flooring.

Get your roof replacement estimate now
